explanation.summary: You had surgery to replace your right hip on October 14, 2026, because of severe arthritis in that hip. The surgery went well. You are now walking with a walker.

m1.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet by mouth 2 times a day, at 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Take it for 35 days. Your last dose is on 11/20/2026.

m2.how_to_take: Take 2 tablets by mouth 3 times a day, every 8 hours, at 6:00 AM, 2:00 PM, and 10:00 PM.
tips: Do not take more than 3,000 mg of acetaminophen in 24 hours, counting all sources.

m3.what_for: For severe pain that acetaminophen does not fix.
m3.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet by mouth only when you need it, every 6 hours. Do not take more than 4 tablets in one day.
tips: Do not drive or drink alcohol while taking this medicine.

m4.how_to_take: Take 1 capsule by mouth 2 times a day, at 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM, while you are taking oxycodone.
tips: Take this while you are taking oxycodone.

m5.what_for: For nausea (feeling sick to your stomach).
m5.how_to_take: Put 1 tablet under your tongue only when you need it, every 8 hours, for nausea.
tips: Let the tablet dissolve under your tongue.

m6.how_to_take: Take 1 tablet by mouth once a day at 7:00 AM, on an empty stomach, 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast.
tips: Take on an empty stomach, 30 to 60 minutes before you eat breakfast.

m7.how_to_take: Take Vitamin D as directed. This paper does not give an exact dose or schedule.
tips: Ask your doctor or pharmacist for the exact dose and how often to take it.

m8.how_to_take: Do not take aspirin 81 mg right now. It is being held while you take apixaban. Only start it again if your surgeon tells you to.
tips: Do not restart aspirin unless your surgeon says it is okay.

signs: You have chest pain or sudden trouble breathing.
One calf (lower leg) becomes swollen, red, or painful.
You have black or bloody stools, or you throw up blood.
Your hip feels like it popped out of place.
You cannot put any weight on your leg.

i1.text: For 6 weeks, follow your hip rules: do not bend your hip past 90 degrees, do not cross your legs, and do not twist on the leg that had surgery.

i2.text: Always use your walker when you walk.

i3.text: Keep the bandage over your cut clean and dry.

i4.text: You may shower after 5 days, but keep the bandage covered.

i5.text: Do not take baths, use a hot tub, or swim until your surgeon says it is okay.

a1.text: You have a visit with Orthopedics, Dr. Michael Okafor, on 10/29/2026 at 1:00 PM. It is at Maplewood Orthopedic Clinic, Building B. This visit is to remove your staples and check your wound.

a2.text: Home physical therapy will call you within 48 hours to set up your visits. Their number is (203) 555-0166.
